# very lift

> A strength-challenge platform for friend groups. Connects to your Liftosaur
> workout log and automatically scores your lifts against the goal chart you
> set for yourself, so everyone tracks progress against their own targets
> without double-entering data.

very lift is open source (PolyForm Shield License) and self-hostable via
Docker. Most pages require a logged-in account, so this file points at what's
actually reachable without one: the marketing site, legal pages, and the
public docs on GitHub.

- [Self-hosting guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/verylift/verylift/main/docs/self-hosting.md)
